mapper.sql: d.id, d.task_id, t.title AS task_title, d.project_id, p.name AS project_name, d.ai_level, d.effective_level, r.name AS matched_rule_name, d.status, d.question, d.options, d.recommendation, d.reversible, d.blast_radius, d.resolved_by, d.resolved_choice, d.resolution_note, d.raised_at, d.resolved_at
FROM decision d JOIN task t ON t.id = d.task_id JOIN project p ON p.id = d.project_id LEFT JOIN decision_rule r ON r.id = d.matched_rule_id

sql.if: AND (d.question LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR t.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
